address: via Fava 18, Orta San Giulio, 28016, Italy
bio: Just a stone’s throw from the enchanting village of Orta San Giulio with its picture-postcard views of the lake and San Giulio island, this three-Michelin-star restaurant boasts a stunning location in a late-19C Moorish-style villa. Impressive both inside and out, this aristocratic residence was once the home of the Crespi family. Today, the villa’s leading light is Antonino Cannavacciuolo, who is now at the helm of a number of Michelin-starred restaurants, of which the Villa Crespi, the most famous and celebrated of them all, is the flagship. Although this chef originally from Vico Equense in Campania takes inspiration from all over Italy and further afield, it is the passion, colour and intense flavours of his native region that shine through in all his dishes.
